verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents workflows that automate processes and timed email sequences. It also documents AI agents that act on their own: a prospecting agent that watches for buying signals and reaches out automatically, and smart deal progression that handles next steps after calls. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of workflow triggers, scheduling and background execution; clarity on how far agents run without the human approval step implied for post-meeting CRM updates; and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run autonomously.
